description: Save a design export JSON (frames with node trees, as the plugin produces) as a snapshot, so its nodes can be read without the plugin. Use it for an export made earlier with save_design_export or the plugin. Copies the file into the local snapshot store, replacing an earlier snapshot of the same frames; the source file and the Figma file are not changed. Fails if the JSON is not a design export.

path.description: Absolute path of the export JSON file.

name: import_design_export
title: Import Design Export
